epics.sixSigmaMetric: Number of unresolved audit findings carried over into production
requirements: R1: Fix HTTP 401 errors on core endpoints (employee dossier search, document listing) to correctly answer 200/201.
R2: Implement Moodle course-based access control for closed strains and analytical reports based on departments and courses.
R3: Enforce strict PR approval rules ensuring APPROVE verdicts are only granted when all requirements are fully implemented.

slices.title: Resolve omitted backend functionality and enforce PR approval standards
slices.jtbd: When implementing the omitted backend features for this epic, I want to fix API authentication and Moodle access controls and ensure the code review strictly validates these requirements, so that the self-falsification findings are completely resolved without inventing adjacent scope.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a valid request to employee dossier search or document listing, When the endpoint is called, Then it must return a 200/201 status code instead of a 401 error.
Given a user belonging to specific Moodle departments or courses, When they attempt to access closed strains or analytical reports, Then the system automatically restricts or grants access based on their Moodle context.
Given a code review for this implementation, When the reviewer evaluates the PR, Then an APPROVE decision is only granted if both the HTTP 401 fixes and the Moodle access controls are demonstrably implemented in code.
slices.tocConstraintRef: API authentication and access control logic
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero HTTP 401 errors on verified valid requests and zero unauthorized access to closed reports
